svg.title: Atomically erase account and owned data

g.text: Atomically erase account and owned data
02_access_authentication: resolve active bearer session or return 401
Invalid request parameters / body return 422 before service execution.
Word deletion cascades to its PromptJob.
The erasure marker satisfies deletion protection triggers.
Concurrent account mutations serialize on the User lock.
Workers recheck account and lease before persisting generated data.
